faq.meta_description: Common questions about BIT’s scope, audience and way of working.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions

items.q: Does BIT replace an in-house IT department?
items.a: BIT is for smaller companies that do not need a full internal IT role, but want one central contact for defined user, access and workplace services.
Smaller companies with about 5–50 employees, mostly on Windows and Microsoft 365, without a dedicated IT role — Zurich and remote across Switzerland.

items.q: Can every IT problem be covered?
items.a: No. BIT focuses on user, access, Microsoft 365 and standardised workplace services. For more complex specialist topics, BIT first checks whether they can be handled or coordinated within the service.

items.q: Does BIT only work with hotels?
items.a: No. Hotels and front desk are one experience example. The offer is aimed at smaller Swiss companies without in-house IT.

BIT owns the commissioned service and remains your contact. Standardised tasks are delivered inside the BIT service. When specialist expertise is required, BIT coordinates suitable specialist work within the agreed engagement.
Permission and access changes only happen after documented approval by a person authorised by the company.

items.q: Are there fixed packages or prices?
items.a: The IT basics check starts at CHF 190. Further services are offered by scope as a fixed price, recurring service, or — for additional special effort — after prior approval. Before work starts, you receive the agreed scope and price. Remote is the default; Zurich-area on-site visits are agreed separately.
Reply usually within two working days.

items.q: Must our IT already be documented?
items.a: No. Especially when users, access or ownership are poorly documented, the IT basics check can serve as a starting point.
